_comment: Delta patch for knowledge/graph/agentic_universe_graph.json. Generic node/edge shape — adapt to agentic_universe_schema.json and validate with tools/knowledge_graph.py before applying. Dedupe nodes if earlier patches already added them.

nodes.label: Skill allowlist registry
nodes.summary: Internal skill registry with signed skills, version pinning, and retrieval precision monitoring; log injected schemas; treat skills as executable code from untrusted sources.

nodes.label: MCP server allowlist (GitHub Copilot)
nodes.summary: Enterprise managed settings with allowedMcpServers/deniedMcpServers; enforced in Copilot app, CLI, VS Code; deny‑wins, fail‑closed default; URL and argv matchers.

nodes.label: Agentic OS vs runtime split
nodes.summary: Two internal planes — Control & Governance (intent, policy, trust, authority, audit, HITL) and Runtime & Coordination (lifecycle, workflow, model/tool routing, context/memory, scheduling, traffic, assurance).

summary.label: Compaction safety
summary.summary: Compact to schema (JSON) not prose; validate state on transitions; keep policies outside the agent's edit surface, enforced at the gateway; measure policy violations before/after compaction.

summary.label: Fleet control plane
summary.summary: Persistent gateway registry with health checks; unify bot/chat rosters; measure operator overhead reduction; support bot‑to‑bot DMs across gateways (Hermes hermes peer).

summary.label: OpenAI Agents SDK
summary.summary: Native sandbox execution, model‑native harness; Responses API is the primary primitive for agent runs; Agents SDK updated Aug 2026 with sandbox + harness.

summary.label: Mastra (TypeScript agent framework)
summary.summary: TypeScript‑first, batteries‑included (agents, workflows, memory, evals, MCP, Studio); closest to full‑stack agent framework in TS.
